comment: FinalMask filter cases with what `xray run -test` of Xray-core v26.11.9 says of each: "ok" or a substring of its error. A client validates a filter and then ignores it, as Xray-core's does. "ours" records a deliberate difference of the parser, for the reason in "why"; "core" a refusal of the core when it is built. The geodata cases assume no geoip.dat beside the binary or in Xray-core's asset directories. Rechecked by scripts/check-config-verdicts.py in scripts/check-xray-verdicts.sh.

cases.name: hysteria filters around salamander and noise
masque h2 tcp and udp filters
xdrive google drive h3 tcp filter
xdrive google drive h3 udp filter
cases.xray: infra/conf: XDRIVE: over h3 to Google Drive the only "udp" mask that works is "noise", not "filter"

cases.name: tcp filters around fragment and header-custom
udp filter after udphop
cases.why: Xray-core accepts it and fails every dial with `incorrect index: 1 *udphop.Config` (checked live): its check counts a filter's place like any mask's.

cases.name: udp filter after xicmp
cases.why: Xray-core accepts it and fails every dial with `incorrect index: 1 *xicmp.Config` (checked live): its check counts a filter's place like any mask's.
